headline:
Found by Search

shortDescription: The fundamentals that get trade businesses found — by traditional search engines and by the new generation of AI answer engines. Location-aware pages, LocalBusiness schema, clean structure, and content written to be quotable.
lead: Search has two halves now: traditional engines (Google, Bing) and AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Google's AI Overviews). Both read your site — differently. We build the technical foundation and the content structure that makes trade-business websites legible to both, so when someone searches or asks "who fixes water heaters in Denver," your site is the one cited.

sections.heading: What You Get
sections.intro: Foundational SEO plus AI engine optimization, baked into your site from day one.

items.label: LocalBusiness & service-area schema
items.body: Structured data so search engines and AI models can read your name, location, services, license info, and hours cleanly

items.label: Service / trade page architecture
items.body: One page per service line or trade — real pages with unique content, not doorway templates

items.label: Content written to be quotable
items.body: Short, factual lines that AI answer engines can lift as direct quotes when someone asks about a trade or service in your area

items.label: Clean heading hierarchy
items.body: Proper H1/H2/H3 structure so both crawlers and LLMs can parse what each page is actually about

items.label: AI engine summary file (llms.txt)
items.body: A short, plain-English summary of your business written specifically for ChatGPT-style search engines — we maintain it as your services change

items.label: Sitemap & robots.txt
items.body: Auto-generated, submitted to Google and Bing at launch, and kept in sync when pages change

items.label: Title tags & meta descriptions
items.body: Written for every page — clean snippets for search results and AI citations

items.label: Image alt text
items.body: Every photo described properly — accessibility, SEO, and context for multimodal AI

sections.heading: Why AI Search Optimization Matters Now
sections.body: More homeowners are asking ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google's AI Overviews before they click into a results page at all. A site that only optimizes for 2015-era SEO gets skipped:
items: AI answer engines quote sites that are factually structured — not sites stuffed with repetitive keyword filler
Pages structured for Google to read also help AI engines cite you confidently; prose-only pages get paraphrased past
Our short AI-engine summary file lets ChatGPT-style engines understand your services without having to crawl every page
Traditional SEO fundamentals still matter — this adds to them, not replaces them

sections.heading: What This Is Not
sections.body: We don't sell "SEO packages" that promise the top of Google or guarantee AI citations. Those are almost always scams. What we do:
items: The technical fundamentals every site should have
A site structure that makes your services and service area legible to both search crawlers and LLMs
Content patterns that hold up as search continues to shift toward answers
A strong foundation for any future SEO or content work

sections.heading: Perfect For

items.label: Riding directories, ready to be found

items.body: Some agency charged $1,200/mo for 18 months, sent monthly PDF reports full of green arrows, and the estimate-request inbox stayed empty. You're done with promises and want the technical fundamentals done once, properly.

serviceFaq.heading: Common Questions about Search & AI Optimization

faqs.question: How long until I rank for my trade in my city?
faqs.answer: Foundational ranking signals (schema, sitemap, location pages) start working within days of indexing. Competing for a top spot in a contested area takes months and depends on backlinks and reviews — not just on-site SEO. We install the foundation; ongoing content and reputation work builds on top of it.

faqs.question: Do I have to write the SEO content myself?
faqs.answer: No. We draft the location pages, service descriptions, and AI-quotable summaries from your intake. You review and tweak. If you'd rather lead the writing, we leave the structure ready for your copy.

faqs.question: What's actually different about AI engine optimization?
faqs.answer: AI engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google's AI Overviews) cite sites that are factually structured — short, declarative lines, pages structured for Google to read, and a maintained AI-engine summary file. We bake those patterns into every page, alongside the traditional SEO fundamentals.

faqs.question: Will you set up structured data (schema)?
faqs.answer: Yes. LocalBusiness, Service, and FAQ schema are wired in at build time. Search engines and LLMs both use this — it's how your services, hours, and service area show up cleanly in results and citations.

faqs.question: Do I need a separate SEO retainer on top of this?
faqs.answer: No, not for the technical fundamentals. If you want ongoing content marketing or backlink building, that's a separate scope — we'll point you to honest options if it's a fit. Most solo operators don't need it.
